isolation.note: Verified against OpenCode 1.18.31 (verified live during development): OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT is honored as an inline config override; tools.{"*": false} disables every tool, permission.{"*": "deny"} denies execution, plugin [] and --pure drop plugins, mcp {} drops MCP servers, and a live probe confirmed the model can emit no executing tool calls. Residual limitation: OpenCode merges user-global config (~/.config/opencode) and managed settings that this harness cannot un-merge, so globally declared plugins/MCP servers may still be loaded (their execution remains denied). Claim: denied tool EXECUTION in a fresh session and fresh temp cwd; NOT a hermetic sandbox.

objective: minimize total DMA input bytes, then command count

model.cwd_policy: fresh system-temp directory outside the repository

proposal.rationale: Weight-stationary 16x16 tiles: A k-half tiles loaded once to spad rows 0 and 16; for each of the 5 n-blocks, B tile (k=0..15) is mvin'd to spad row 32, overwrite-computed with A k-half 0 (k-order 0..15), then B tile (k=16..31) mvin'd to the same spad rows, accumulate-computed with A k-half 1 (k-order 16..31), and mvout from accumulator rows 0-15 (bit31+bit29 set; bit30 distinguishes overwrite 2684354560 vs accumulate 3758096384). Scratchpad usage peaks at 48 of 80 rows. Total mvin bytes = 2*256 (A) + 10*256 (B) = 3072, the minimum since every B tile is used exactly once and each A tile is loaded a single time for all 5 reuses; 42 commands with one final fence.

proposal.rationale: Resubmission of the accepted round-1 stream, which is provably optimal on both objectives. DMA lower bound: each of the 10 distinct B tiles (2 k-halves x 5 n-blocks) is used in exactly one 16x16x16 product, so all 10 must be mvin'd (2560 bytes), plus the 2 A k-half tiles loaded once for all 5 reuses (512 bytes) = 3072 bytes, achieved here. Command lower bound: 1 config_ex + 2 config_ld (both slots used) + 1 config_st + 12 mvin (12 distinct 16x16 tiles, one per mvin) + 10 preload (each compute consumes exactly one preload) + 10 compute (10 required 16x16x16 products) + 5 mvout (C is five 16x16 tiles) + 1 fence = 42, achieved here. Semantics: A k-halves at spad rows 0 and 16; per n-block j, B tile (k=0..15, offset 16j) is mvin'd to spad row 32, preload with out_addr 2684354560 (bit31 accumulator + bit29 full width + bit30=0 overwrite, acc row 0), overwrite-compute with A k-half 0 (k-order 0..15); then B tile (k=16..31, offset 1280+16j) mvin'd to spad row 32, preload with out_addr 3758096384 (bit30=1 accumulate), compute with A k-half 1 giving the ordered k=0..31 reduction; mvout from acc rows 0-15 to C offset 80j. All scratchpad starts are multiples of 16 within 80 rows (peak usage 48), acc rows within [0,16), compute.bd_spad_addr is always 4294967295, and a single final fence closes the stream.
